The y-axis measures 18-24** with scale with a minimum of 0.00 and a maximum of 0.35 while the x-axis measures Year with linear scale with a minimum of 1970 and a maximum of 2010.
caption_L2L3: Overall voter turnout among 18 to 24 year olds generally decreased over the years from 1966 until about 2014. From about 2014 to 2018, there was a sharp increase in voter turnout among 18 to 24 year olds. Voter turnout among 18 to 24 year olds was at its highest in 1966.
